tasks.title: Expose aggregate stage retryability
tasks.description: Add a mutation-free way to determine whether the latest WorkflowRun can retry the issue's current stage using the same guard semantics as WorkflowRun.retryStage(stage). The predicate must remain generic to Stage.name and must not special-case Plan or approval rejection outside the aggregate rules.
acceptanceCriteria: A failed WorkflowRun at its current stage reports retryable when retryStage(stage) would be accepted
A non-failed WorkflowRun reports non-retryable
A failed WorkflowRun for a different current stage reports non-retryable for the requested issue stage
The retryability check does not persist changes or mutate the stored WorkflowRun
WorkflowRun/domain unit tests cover accepted and rejected retryability cases
Typecheck passes
tasks.output: packages/cli/src/workflow/domain/index.ts and related workflow application tests
tasks.notes: Prefer a domain method such as canRetryStage(stage) or an application-service helper that delegates to the aggregate without duplicating retry guards. Do not call retryStage() on the live aggregate merely to test retryability.

tasks.title: Let retryable blocked resumes run
tasks.description: Update resume-pipeline queue execution so a blocked issue is allowed through only when the latest WorkflowRun is retryable for the issue's current stage. Preserve the existing approved-approval continuation path and preserve skipped behavior for genuinely blocked issues without retryable current-stage failures.
acceptanceCriteria: Blocked issue with latest failed WorkflowRun at the same current stage is not completed as result=skipped before pipeline execution
resume-pipeline still clears blocked state for approved current-stage approval continuation
Blocked issue without a retryable latest current-stage failed WorkflowRun still completes resume-pipeline as skipped or otherwise remains non-runnable
Queue worker delegates actual retry startup to the existing WorkflowEngine/WorkflowApplicationService retry path
No arbitrary blocked issue is marked active solely because resume-pipeline was enqueued
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This is the core bug fix. Keep AgentRunnerService shallow: evaluate runnable/skipped, then let runPipelineToCompletion and WorkflowEngine perform retryStage().

tasks.title: Record rejection feedback as feedback
tasks.description: Fix rejection recording so the user's rejection message is persisted in WorkflowRun approval rejection history instead of being shadowed by the original approval request output. Preserve useful prior approval context only as context, not as a replacement for the feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: Rejecting stage approval with a message stores that message in the WorkflowRun rejected approval output or failure evidence
Existing approval request output can still be retained as approvalContext when needed
String and structured rejection feedback can both be read back from persisted WorkflowRun state
The rejection API still returns 202 and enqueues resume-pipeline after successful WorkflowRun rejection
Regression tests prove rejection feedback is not replaced by prior Plan approval output
Typecheck passes
tasks.output: packages/cli/src/api/issues.ts and workflow rejection persistence tests
tasks.notes: Current reject flow uses issue.approvalState.output ?? message, which can drop concrete feedback when approval output already exists. Normalize the stored shape with backward-compatible readers.

tasks.title: Feed rejection feedback to retried Plan attempts
tasks.description: Ensure a retry after rejected Plan approval starts a new Plan-stage agent-backed attempt and includes the recorded rejection feedback in the retried stage input context. The retry must regenerate reviewable Plan artifacts and request approval again rather than immediately reusing the previously approved artifact state.
acceptanceCriteria: Plan retry after approval rejection creates a new Plan stage runner/coder session observable through existing session tracking
The retried Plan prompt or task input includes the user's rejection feedback
Plan checkpoint state does not cause the rejected retry to skip all Plan work
The retried Plan stage clears stale approval state and requests approval again after artifacts are ready
No Plan-specific domain entity is introduced; Plan remains Stage.name = plan
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use existing WorkflowRun/stage state/coder_session observability instead of adding a StageAttempt table. Avoid deleting artifacts unless needed for the new attempt to regenerate them deterministically.

tasks.title: Add rejected approval retry regressions
tasks.description: Add focused regression tests for the actual failure path: stage approval rejection, blocked projection, queued resume-pipeline, and same-stage retry execution. Include the negative case proving genuinely blocked issues without retryable current-stage failed WorkflowRuns remain skipped or non-runnable.
acceptanceCriteria: Test covers Plan approval rejection followed by resume-pipeline starting the same stage retry instead of completing as skipped
Test verifies queue task result is not skipped for retryable approval-rejection reruns
Test verifies a new Plan runner/coder session or equivalent observable stage attempt starts after rejection
Test verifies rejection feedback is available to the retried Plan attempt input
Test covers blocked issue without retryable latest current-stage failed WorkflowRun still being skipped/non-runnable
Relevant workflow/API queue tests pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.output: packages/cli/tests/**/*retry*approval*.test.ts or related existing workflow/API regression tests
tasks.notes: Prefer mocked runners/session repos for deterministic tests. The key regression is the queue worker not skipping retryable blocked current-stage failures before WorkflowEngine can call retryStage().
